title: Knife feels good in the my hands but I do not like the thick cutting edge
text:
Knife feels good in the my hands but I do not like the thick cutting edge. This knife has a good grip and feels weighty in the hand. It cuts okay. To me, I feel the cutting edge could be thinner and sharper.

According to the insert, this comes with a lifetime limited warranty. It is also dishwasher safe; however, I prefer to hand wash.

In summary, this is not my favorite paring knife in this price range. I own a Kuhn Rikon paring knife in blue like this [[ASIN:B00168EAPQ one]] that I like much better than this.
